name: Oketo (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Oketo town emblem in green: a broken ring with four spokes enclosing a stylised device.
history: Municipal flag of Oketo, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 31 July 1949.

features.role: Oketo town emblem — a broken ring with four spokes enclosing a stylised device
